verdict.rationale: Bolna documents an official Web Call SDK (bolna-docs-18) under a 'developer-resources/sdks' path, plus a CLI and MCP server, giving AI-native builders some official tooling to build against, but there is no evidence of broader language SDKs (e.g., Python, Node, Go client libraries) beyond the browser-based Web Call SDK. missing for 10: multi-language server-side SDKs, independent/hands-on verification of SDK usability, breadth beyond the single web-call SDK.
